## 60000 - 60108

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60000 TKT - Calculated TOV does not match given TOV</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60000">

This validation and exception applies on edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for all Tank Types other than Horizontal.

If the TOV value is manually entered, FLOWCAL will compare the manually entered TOV to the FLOWCAL calculated TOV. If the values do not match out to product discrimination, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

For example, the Volume unit on the Tank is set to Bbl and has a Product Discrimination of 2 decimals. If the manually entered TOV value on a Tank Gauge ticket is 1000.35 and FLOWCAL calculates that TOV should be 1000.36, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60004 TKT - Current seal off does not match previous seal on</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60004">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of a Tank Run ticket.

FLOWCAL will compare the Seal Off on the current Tank Run ticket to the Seal On from the previous Tank Run ticket on that Tank. If the values do not match, then this exception will be generated.

For example, a Tank Run ticket is created with an effective date of 09/01/2016 09:25:34 that has a Seal On of 135. A Tank Run ticket is then created with an effective date of 09/15/2016 16:13:51 that does not have a value set for Seal Off. Since the Seal On from the previous Tank Run ticket does not match the Seal Off from the new Tank Run ticket, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60005 TKT - Invalid odorant unit imported</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60005">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

The Odorant Unit on the Ticket Data tab of a TFX file is validated on import. If the Odorant Unit has a value other that is not a valid unit, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

The values are case sensitive.

Valid values:

- g = gallons
- p = pounds per 10,000 gallons (lbm/10,000g)
- C = g/cc
- K = kg/m3
- G = pounds per gallon (lbm/gallon )

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60006 TKT - Inactive from facility</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60006">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of all ticket types other than Cavern Level, Inventory Empty, and Product Conversion Tickets.

When a Facility was previously configured to be a From Facility in the Facility Editor, but is then changed to no longer be a valid From Facility, FLOWCAL will mark that Facility as an Inactive From Facility. If a ticket is imported that has a From Facility that FLOWCAL considers to be an Inactive From Facility, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60007">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60007 TKT - Inactive to facility</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60007">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of all ticket types other than Cavern Level, Inventory Empty, and Product Conversion Tickets.

When a Facility was previously configured to be a To Facility in the Facility Editor, but is then changed to no longer be a valid To Facility, FLOWCAL will mark that Facility as an Inactive To Facility. If a ticket is imported that has a To Facility that FLOWCAL considers to be an Inactive To Facility, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60008">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60008 TKT - Facility created on import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60008">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

If the "Create Facilities" option is enabled and a ticket has a From Facility Code or To Facility Code that does not currently exist within FLOWCAL, then FLOWCAL will automatically create the Facility on import. If the ticket is attached to a location and a Facility is automatically created, then this exception will be generated on the location.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60009">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60009 TKT - Invalid movement dates</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60009">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of all ticket types other than Tank Gauge, Inventory Empty, and Product Conversion.

If a ticket is imported that has a Movement Start Date that is greater than the Movement End Date, then this exception will be generated on the ticket.

For example, if a Meter Ticket is imported with a Movement Start Date that is set to 09/01/2016 09:00:00 and a Movement End Date of 09/01/2016 08:59:59, this then exception will be generated because the Movement Start Date has a later date than the Movement End Date.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60026">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60026 TKT - Missing location on ticket import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60026">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

If the Device Type in the import file is set to ‘L’ and the Device Number in the import file does not match a Location Number within FLOWCAL, then the ticket will not be attached to a Location on import and this exception will be generated on the ticket.

The Device Number is not case sensitive.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60027">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60027 TKT - Missing ticket class on ticket import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60027">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

If the Class in the import file does not match a Class within FLOWCAL, then a Class will not be set on the ticket and this exception will be generated.

Class is case sensitive.

For example, a Class called “Check” exists within FLOWCAL. If the Class on the Ticket Data tab of a TFX file is set to “CHECK”, then the ticket will import without a Class and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60028">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60028 TKT - Missing ticket direction on ticket import</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60028">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

If the Direction in the import file does not match a Direction within FLOWCAL, then a Direction will not be set on the ticket and this exception will be generated.

Direction is case sensitive.

For example, a Direction called “Outlet” exists within FLOWCAL. If the Direction on the Ticket Data tab of a TFX file is set to “OUTLET”, then the ticket will import without a Direction and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60029">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60029">

This validation and exception applies on import of a ticket.

If the "Create Shippers" option is not enabled and the shipper in the import file does not match a company name designated as a shipper in the Company Editor, the ticket will import without a shipper and this exception will be generated.

Shipper is case sensitive.

For example, a Company called “ABC Shipping” exists within FLOWCAL and has the Transportation ‘Shipper’ checked. If the Shipper on the String Data tab of a TFX file is set to “abc shipping”, then the ticket will import without a Shipper and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60030">

From Facility Code is not case sensitive.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60040">

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60042">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60042 TKT - Close level difference between tank run and gauge ticket exceeds capacity table resolution</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60042">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets.

If a Tank Run and Tank Gauge ticket exist on a Tank for the same Effective Date, then FLOWCAL will compare the Close Level on the Tank Run ticket to the Level on the Tank Gauge ticket. If the level differs by more than the Table Entry Resolution defined on the Capacity Table, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60043">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60043 GQA - High sediment and water percent</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60043">

This exception is generated for Liquid Quality Sources when the S&W% (on the Additional tab) exceeds 100%. This exception will be validated on Import and Edits. If a user wants to set different min/max validation points for Sediment and Water then the user would need to set a validation on the Product (in the Product Editor).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60044">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60044">

This exception is generated for Liquid Quality Sources when the S&W% (on the Additional tab) is below 0%. This exception will be validated on Import and Edits. If a user wants to set different min/max validation points for Sediment and Water then the user would need to set a validation on the Product (in the Product Editor).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60045">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60045 GQA - High sediment and water correction</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60045">

This exception is generated for Liquid Quality Sources when the CSW (on the Additional tab) exceeds 1. This exception will be validated on Import and Edits. The acceptable range for CSW is anywhere between 0 and 1.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60046">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60046 GQA - Low sediment and water correction</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60046">

This exception is generated for Liquid Quality Sources when the CSW (on the Additional tab) is below 0. This exception will be validated on Import and Edits. The acceptable range for CSW is anywhere between 0 and 1.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60047">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60047 GQA - CSW does not correspond to sediment and water percent</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60047">

This exception is generated for Liquid Quality Sources when the S&W% and CSW (on the Additional tab) do not correlate with each other. For example, if a user set S&W% of 1% and a CSW of 0.98000 (indicative of S&W% set to 2%), this exception would generate since the data doesn’t correlate together.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60048">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60048 TKT – Level not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60048">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Level field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Level is missing, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60049">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60049 TKT – Liquid temperature not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60049">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Liquid Temperature field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Liquid Temperature is missing, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

If the Use Steel Temperature Correction (CTS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is enabled, CTS (liquid) and CTS (vapor) will not be calculated.

CTL will not be calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60050">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60050 TKT – Liquid pressure not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60050">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Tank Pressure field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Tank Pressure is missing, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

If the Use Steel Pressure Correction (CPS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is enabled, Shell Pressure Correction will not be calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60051">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60051 TKT – Observed temperature not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60051">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Observed Temperature field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Observed Temperature is missing, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

CTL, Base Density, and Vapor Density will not be calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60052">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60052 TKT – Observed density not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60052">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Observed Density field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Observed Temperature is missing, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

CTL, Base Density, and Vapor Density will not be calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60053">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60053 TKT – Valid analysis (liquid volume %) not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60053">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved without a value in the Vapor Density field; and without a valid analysis, specifically Liquid Volume %, so that Vapor Density could not be calculated. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Vapor Density is missing, and there is no valid analysis on the ticket. For a run ticket, it will not be resolved until both Vapor Density values are provided or a valid analysis is provided.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60055">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60055 TKT – Base density too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60055">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. Vapor Density calculation method is limited to the base density range of 0.4 to 0.65 Relative Density. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with data that results in a base density greater than 0.65 REL.

For example, a tank gauge ticket has a Table E product; Observed Density of 0.6388 REL; Observed Temperature of 86°F; and Observed Pressure of 130 psig. When the ticket is saved, the base density is calculated to be 0.6506 REL. This is greater than 0.65 REL, and this exception is generated.

Vapor Density will not be calculated.

For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Base Density is greater than 0.65 REL, and will not be resolved until both base densities are below the limit.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60056">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60056 TKT – Base density too low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60056">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. Vapor Density calculation method is limited to the base density range of 0.4 to 0.65 Relative Density. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with data that results in a base density less than 0.4 REL.

For example, a tank gauge ticket has a Table E product; Observed Density of 0.4205 REL; Observed Temperature of 33°F; and Observed Pressure of 105 psig. When the ticket is saved, the base density is calculated to be 0.3863 REL. This is less than 0.4 REL, and this exception is generated.

Vapor Density will not be calculated.

For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Base Density is less than 0.4 REL, and will not be resolved until both base densities are above the limit.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60057">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60057 TKT – Observed pressure too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60057">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. The Vapor Density calculation uncertainty increases when the observed pressure is above 280 psia. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with an observed pressure greater than 280 psia.

For example, a tank gauge ticket has an observed pressure of 267 psi. The pressure gauge is Gauge and the atmospheric pressure is 14.7 psi. Then the observed pressure is 281.7 psia. This is above 280 psia, and this exception is generated.

Vapor Density will not be calculated.

For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Observed Pressure is above 280 psia, and will not be resolved until both pressures are below the limit.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60058">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60058 TKT – Observed temperature too high</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60058">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. Vapor Density calculation method is limited to the product temperatures of -40°F to 140°F. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with an observed temperature higher than 140°F.

Vapor Density will not be calculated.

For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Observed Temperature is higher than 140°F, and will not be resolved until both base temperatures are below the limit.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60059">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60059 TKT – Observed temperature too low</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60059">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. Vapor Density calculation method is limited to the product temperatures of -40°F to 140°F. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with an observed temperature lower than -40°F.

Vapor Density will not be calculated.

For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Observed Temperature is lower than -40°F, and will not be resolved until both base temperatures are above the limit.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60060">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60060 TKT – Correction for shell temperature not available</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60060">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with either CTS (vapor) or CTS (liquid) fields having no value. If the Use Steel Temperature Correction (CTS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is not enabled, CTS (liquid) and CTS (vapor) will be set to 1 so that this exception will not be applicable.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60061">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60061 TKT – CTL not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60061">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved and CTL value is not imported and cannot be calculated.

For example, a tank gauge ticket is imported and the import data does not include observed temperature and CTL. FLOWCAL will not be able to calculate CTL with observed temperature missing. Since CTL is not imported or calculated, this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60062">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />60062 TKT – Total observed volume not given</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60062">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Total Observed Volume. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Total Observed Volume is not imported or cannot be calculated, and will not be resolved until both are imported or calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60063">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60063">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Vapor Density. For a gauge ticket, it is labelled Vapor Base Density. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Vapor Density is not imported or cannot be calculated, and will not be resolved until both are imported or calculated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60065">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of Tank Gauge and Tank Run tickets for the Spherical Tank Type. This exception is generated when a tank ticket is saved with no value in the Vapor Temperature field. For a run ticket, this exception will be generated if either Open or Close Vapor Temperature is not provided, and will not be resolved until both are provided.

If the Use Steel Temperature Correction (CTS) for Calculations option on the Capacity Table editor is enabled, CTS (vapor) will not be calculated.

</div>
